steps.review: A platform administrator reviews the application.
steps.approved: Once approved, the Organizer portal appears in the menu and you can create events.
steps.publish: Free events can be published straight away. Paid events also need a sandbox paid-sales checklist and a separate admin review.

signedOut.prompt: Sign in or create an account to apply as an organizer.

organizer.body: Your account can already create and manage events.

application.title: Your application
application.pendingBody: A platform administrator is reviewing your application. You will get a notification when it is decided.
application.approvedBody: Approved. Refresh your access to open the organizer portal.
application.rejectedBody: Your application was rejected. Check your notifications for the administrator's reason, update your details and apply again.
